subject: Banking
title: The LIBOR Scandal
description: A short lesson to help you apply The LIBOR Scandal.

hook.text: LIBOR set interest rates for $350 trillion in financial products.

buildup.text: LIBOR was calculated from self-reported borrowing rates from major banks. No one verified the numbers.

discovery.text: Traders at Barclays, UBS, and Deutsche Bank colluded to manipulate LIBOR.

twist.text: During the 2008 crisis, banks reported artificially low LIBOR to appear healthier.

climax.text: LIBOR fraud affected every mortgage, student loan, and credit card on Earth.

punchline.text: $350 trillion affected. Banks rigged the most trusted rate. LIBOR was a lie.

quiz.question: How much in financial products was affected by LIBOR manipulation?
